notes.title: New Game Mode
notes.content:
I guess no one told these eggs not to run with scissors, because that is eggsactly what they've started doing to pass the time in their corporate 9-5.

Not just running, but jumping, rolling, and most importantly, cutting the other eggs down to size.

In the newest free-for-all game mode [i]Eggs Royale[/i] the eggs must compete in armed combat, using very, very small pairs of scissors to eliminate one another and be the last egg standing.

notes.title: Shell Corp Demo + PAX Online/EGX Digital
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36753648/653301c539af251ac51d5e69b7f945016aef1e1c.png[/img]

[h2]Shell Corp @ PAX x EGX (12/9 - 20/9)[/h2]
We're super eggcited to announce that Shell Corp is heading to PAX x EGX from September 12 – 20! You can catch us at the Shell Corp virtual booth next week. Entry is free and the show is all digital, so you can explore the from the comfort of your own home!

You can mind more news, announcements, and what'll other cool games and panels be on the show floor here! [url=https://www.paxegx.com/]https://www.paxegx.com/[/url]

[h1]BUT THAT'S NOT ALL...[/h1]

[h2]Shell Corp Demo - Available Now![/h2]
To celebrate, we're launching a Shell Corp Demo for all the world to eggsperience! And we thought it'd be a nice treat to release it early for you folks! 

The Demo Includes 2 of Shell Corps 7 games modes, one solo, one team (Shell Smash and Hold The Fork). You can create, paint, and customise 8 eggs (32 in the full game). The demo does not include any of the many unlockables featured in the full game, but you can still play with up to 8 players locally!

Throughout PAX x EGX we'll be having some fun events ourselves, like eggpainting contests! With the demo now out anyone can join in the fun! Keep an eye out for more announcements related to PAXEGX, we have some fun stuff in store. See ya there!

[list]
[*] Dying in a coffee patch should no longer respawn you all slippery
[*] AI who were added automatically to balance the teams now feature in the team results screen
[*] A bug which sometimes caused countdown text to be too large was fixed
[*] The painting was made easier by having a paintbrush be automatically selected when you select a colour and currently have the eraser selected
[/list]

notes.title: Shell Corp Launches August 21st!
notes.content:
We're super eggcited to finally announce that Shell Corp will be launching on August 21st at £9.99! 

Just a week away!! It's been a long road, but we hope we've made something you'll all enjoy :) Get those controllers ready, and let your friends know too! 

[previewyoutube=fODGfsvjzA4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Big Trailer Time! (and even more customisation options?!)
notes.content:
We've added an eggciting new trailer (and nifty new screenshots) to Shell Corp's store page, showcasing updated wacky 8 player gameplay, and all-new fun features! 

We've been hard at work finishing the game... but finishing a game was simply not enough! We have also added additional customisation options and unlockables! Instead of just simply painting your eggs, you will now be able to dress up and pick your favourite tie, and give your egg a unique voice to emote with! 

You can easily unlock many more ties, voices, and paints the more you play!

[b]Also! [/b] Keep an eye out for more posts in the near future, as we'll have more great news to share very soon! 

(Yes, we know eggs don't have eyes, roll with us)
